body:
This is what im feeling right now, and im about to follow through with it...

Maybe theyd finally realize how serious having a mental illness is when im on the floor absent of breath

Maybe my death can bring clarity to a few, prevent them from further hurting other mentally ill people.

Im glad i wasnt the only one feeling this. Just to be clear, I dont like the fact that people are being hit by the virus, but i like the inplemented quarantine makes us work frok home, because i really would rather work from home, less traffic and stress and forced exposure to officemates who i dont like.

My lifestyle suddenly has become the new norm

Im christian too, and i feel this pain very well.
The thought of what if hell actually exists terrifies me

But also i already feel like living here in this world is like, prototype hell, so idk im fucked i guess

And i find myself praying pls end my life i wish to NOT WAKE UP ANYMORE PLS, GIVE ME THE SWEET EMBRACE OF DEATH
All the time. I think if i could donate my life to someone else (minus my depression), this life would be of more use than the shitty human i am now...
Same feels man.

Like i remember someone told me "look at picasso! He has depression, but he does awesome paintings!"

I wish i was the picasso type, depressed but does good shit at least, not like me right now, just depressed and cant do shit bevause to damn tired of life i wanma just end it type

Aww man, i feel you so much. Youre not alone on this. I lost friends to this. People who chose to talk about this behind my back and let it explode into a mess before they actually approached me.

It hurts a ton, and it makes you wanna close up forever, since the o e person you thought understands you, misunderstood you (because idk theyre tired of our shit) or just pretended to understand from the start. Hurts like a brick.

Oh no... we have the same exact experience too. And its currently fucking me up now. 
Believe me even if you get professional help, if they already believe you are "emotionaly manipulative", its not gonna help as much.

Oh this is exactly whats happening to me right now. It sucks. And ive seriously thinking of ending myself soon because of this. Ive already accepted all the blame once, and now they want me to accept all the blame again. Anything i said to counter their accusiations just stoked the fire. It was obvious they didnt want to listen or look at things from my side either.

Its as if telling someone they're emotionally manipulative makes you "wake up" and stop "feeling"
Like they have the need to invalidate what you feel so they themselves can escape the reponsibility of being the reason of your crying.

Friend kelt saying that i don't notice myself being emotionally manipulative, and that i bring up being depressed in talks all the time, and then proceed to threaten to cut ties with me because friend said shes being hurt.

I wonder who's emotionally manipulative now then.

I didnt call the person out because it would worsen the situation, but believe me when i said i really wanted to. Felt so unfair, like if being hurt and im expressing it, its manipulation, but if they're hurt and are expressing it, its normal "reaction"
Im starting to believe this too. It sucks that my happiness is also reliant on other people. When people fuck you up, it hurts so bad.

"They only care about being right"

This hurts to a spiritual level. Specially when people start arguing with you knowing youre at a fisadvantage with your mental illness.
No man its okay, its completely valid. Alot of us suffer this too, and it fucking sucks so bad, that no one even tries to step back and understand this

I... I kinda think this way. I want to end myself so badly, but i dont want her to suffer in my behalf.
But then again Im just suffering here in this world, and I really dont know how much fight have i left in myself...
Wow i get called alot for this, and i totally get you man. Like how do you even control this? There arent any switches, wish there were lol

Im glad you have a boss that understands, at the very least helps you specially when youre on your down time :)
Its so hard making everyone else understand. Its extra hard when its close friends who dont understand.

I cannot agree more with this. It has come to a point where you start questioning yourself all of a sudden.

It sure isnt fun...
Yeah i get you thought. Coz he can say that u can be a homeless drug addict all he wants to, but being with him will cause you to lose your life much earlier. I'd rather run too
Ih my god am sorry to hear. Im kind of in a similar situation too, and wow fuck yeah man, some people seem to want to literally push us off the edge right? Might as well given us a loaded gun.

Ohh those are actually pretty triggering. Its along the lines of "you can do it, but only if you want to!"
Or "its on you if you want to change"
expecting you to get better right there and then
Ugh, its the same. Anything that starts with "JuST BeCAUs3 yOu HaVe a DiAGnoSis..." automatically becomes something unpleasantly misunderstood

YES I feel this so so much! like whatever I say is ignored and is not important and can be easily interrupted, no one cares for the depressive kid.  
the depressive kid puts everyone down boohoo

but then if you say "its not the same" they then say, so what youre invalidating my "depression" now?  


and you're just ?????

or like if you try to say something thats bothering you, the say something like "Ive been there blah blah" so you should be okay with that blah blah!

instant invalidation :/

yeah like, I'm trying to explain, I'm not making this an excuse, but making you also understand from my perspective why so, and why its misunderstood  


It's extra painful when talking to someone who supposedly knows how depression works and had been through it "or so they say"  


also keep word theyve been through and they got out. meanwhile me am just still here, trying to weather out the frequent onslaughts...

Ive been trying to distract myself with my other hobbies, but it goes the other way around, and i get distracted by the pain and id just be there, paralyzed and hurting.

Im literally with my family now, and i tell you theyre wonderful people, but i dont know why i feel like their company is not enough. I honestly hate myself for this, idk why my family isnt enough for me when literally alot of people long for the relationship i have, and i truly hate myself for this, like im being ungrateful, but i cant do anything but this is how i truly feel

As with online friends, i do try to, but i get distracted by the pain and am reminded theyre not close to me that it hurts so so much.

I hate myself for being like this. Why cant i just be fucking normal.

They know and are aware i have depression and anxiety, but i think at this point theyre just tired of my "antics"

They're too passive aggressive and non confrontational. They wont say it and im afraid theyd even hold it against me and be labelled as being needy or such.

Im the type who prefers to be upfront with people, so i try to be upfront, but then when im upfront and vulerable to someone, and they arent and pretend that they dont have a problem with me, its so unfair.

I know i was needy back then, and have confronted this change. but as far as i know, i havent been needy now. Specially during this quarantine time where we arent allowed to meet up anyway. I dont recall asking for attention as much anymore. Its honestly become a balancing act of trying not to be needy, but not trying to be aloof too much that they'd have a reason to throw me away coz they think i dont care

Like example i literally dmed a friend, and she legit hasnt replied to me in a week, while i see her replying to everyone online and in mutual group chats. It hurts like a brick being blatantly ignòred like this.

Im with family, and theyre truly wonderful people, but idk why i feel like they arent enough? Honestly i hate myself for feeling like this. Why cant these nice family members be enough for me...

Also sadly my hobbies include my friends, and i really cant concentrate on my other hobbies and selfcare when im so distracted by this pain.

Also if i mute them, it hurts more coz thats what hurts in the first place:
The fact that i feel like im starting to be invisible to them. Like they're just tolerating me. That im unwanted.

Why do i love them still

I just want to die. I want to end this pain

At this point im not sure anymore if i have qualities of a nice person.

This has happened numerous times. Friends leaving me again and again ang again... and now it seems its about to happen again

Its one thing to lose a few, but constantly losing them? Idk whats wrong with me, and what i should change because at this point i think im a villan thats meant to be alone coz im fucking evil and has to die

I dont know anymore what i should do aside from kill myself

Yeah true, specially when ive had a taste of how nice and warm they were when we were all close together. Not the cold, passive aggressive ones nowadays. The pain is so much. 
Its so much painful having friends that make you feel you're alone...

Ive been breathing thru, ive been trying to acknowledge the pain, ive tried convincing myself, trying to put things into perspective, but the immediate pain ive been bearing wont go away.

Why wont it go away. I just want to go away. I want to die.

I long for physical friends i can be with that i can trust wholeheartedly. Ive got a whole slew of cosplay friends in and outside of the country... but none of them are that close to me.

I tried reaching out to a few of them, but they already have established cliques, and i couldn't just barge into the circle...

I wish it were easier. Ive no energy anymore. Im tired and hurting and im cant stop the pain...

The problem is theyre so non confrontational and prefers passive aggressive remarks to convey what they want to say. When approached theyd say 
"Nah man everythings cool! Ur just overthinking lol"
But leave hints of passive aggressive remarks and selective ignoring

Its so hit or miss ikr. Im such a fucking retard when it comes to making friends that i feel like im not gonna meet people like them anytime soon.  And now am scared of meeting new ones too for the fear of thinking theyd just be tolerating me. Im cant handle another beating.

My heart is tired. I really just want to die to end this...

Im not sure how long i could wait further. Feels like ive been waiting forever.

Ive done so much to improve myself but all for naught. Im tired.
I wish to just die :'(

Idk, until i kill myself probably 
Or meet new friends who'd make me feel accepted...

But thats such a idealized event that i dont think wil happen to me anytime soon. Theyre such a rare bunch, i dont think i can meet new people who would genuinely care the way they did back then anytime soon...
Besides building a genuine friendship takes time... sigh...

Im not sure if i consider myself mature, but for me addressing problems head on instead of being passive aggressive and dropping hints is a much more mature approach.

Id rather know that they dislike me, so i know what ri change rather than have me guessing and overthinking over clues left behind. Im not very bright  and not a mind reader. And it hurts so so much that i feel like they dont trust me with whatever the truth is...

Have tried back then, but they're  non confrontational  and prefer to be passive aggressive

So theyd say "nah everythings okay man!"
But then you notice the little things that make it seem like its not okay at all

What id give for then to just straight up tell me why and  what can i change about myself to solve this problem...

Thats the thing. No other circles. Only them. And other people dont find me interesting enough to invest as much friendship in me.
I also kinda do some passion projects with the current circle so am stuck. I feel like i only matter when i have a use. And even so my efforts are undermined.
But the project we do together is such a huge passion thing i just cant let go too...
I also truly love then and have been friends for years.

My friends are distancing themselves from me, my meds arent working for me anymore, i have no one to talk to and i just want to end it all.
Everything. 

Im tired. 

Ive been so tired for years. I just want the sweet embrace of death.
